note: 台词审（口播＋屏幕文字）。tools/edu_review.py new / check / issues 读这里；改标准只改这里。口播与屏幕文字标准不同，中英各自由本语言母语审稿人审。所有新审查每项使用一位 Kimi 独立审稿人：models 只留 a 位，a 位评分即最终分，不对比、不裁决；旧双审记录仍可读取。口播审稿逐句写「跟朋友会怎么说」再对比；程序口语黑名单先标可疑句；开场、串场、章节过渡、片尾与章节标题有一点怪就算必改，各轮不放宽。
scoring: 1：有问题（问题表里必须有对应条目）
2：基本没问题，有小瑕疵（写证据）
证据要指到句号 lNN / 屏号、原文或数字，至少 8 个字；没证据的高分按 0 处理。
单审：a 位评分即最终分。（双审时：两位同一维度差 ≥2，或一人 ≤1、另一人 ≥2，交裁决人；两人都 ≥2 的维度，裁决人每项抽 2 维复核。）
pass_rule: 每个审稿项的每个维度最终分 ≥2，且没有未处理的「必改」，才算这一项通过；四项都通过才能进配音和渲染。

items.name: 中文口播（母语听感，盲审）
items.who: 你是中文母语观众（国内二十到四十岁、没学过机器学习、爱看 B 站科普的普通人），这期视频你只能「听」。
items.what: 逐句听讲解员的中文：真人讲解会不会这么说、听一遍能不能懂。
items.why: 上一版「本期内容」念成「这一期，讲四件事：它是个什么问题；为什么只背练习册不行……」，像在念目录，正常人不会这么说话（用户 2026-11-08 指出）；原先的审稿没抓到。
dims: 逐句：自然 / 有点怪 / 很怪。书面腔、讲解腔、翻译腔、念稿感、报菜名式罗列都算怪
开场、本期内容、章节转换、举例前后：像一个人顺着思路往下讲，而不是「下面讲第一点」式的模板或目录朗读；上下句接得上
只靠耳朵：一句只带一个新意思；指代清楚（说「这个」时观众知道指什么）；术语先解释再用；数字、同音字不会听错
没有废话、重复、正确的空话；删掉不影响理解的句子要指出来
从头到尾是同一个亲切、清楚、不端着的讲解者；长短句交替，每句适合一口气念完
每句「有点怪 / 很怪」都给出可以直接替换、不更长的中文改写；列出最别扭的 5 句并排序
examples: 「这一期，讲四件事：它是个什么问题；为什么只背练习册不行……」——目录朗读，不是人话（用户 2026-11-08 抓到）
「再聊聊它在现实里闯过的祸，和怎么防。」——名词短语「现实里的祸」加「和怎么防」硬拼，正常人会说「再看看它在现实里惹过什么麻烦，怎么防住它」（用户 2026-11-09 抓到，三轮审稿都放过了）

items.name: English narration (native ear, blind)
items.who: You are a native English speaker (US/UK/Canada/Australia, 20–40, no machine-learning background, watches YouTube explainers like 3Blue1Brown, Veritasium, CGP Grey). You can only HEAR this video.
items.what: Listen line by line: would a real explainer say this, and can you follow it on one hearing?
items.why: The previous agenda read 'In this episode: What the problem is. Why memorizing answers fails. A different way to think about learning…' — a table of contents read aloud. No one talks like that (caught by the user, 2026-11-08); earlier reviews missed it.
dims: Each line: natural / a bit off / clearly off. Written-style, lecture tone, translated-from-Chinese phrasing, telegraphic lists all count as off

Cold open, the 'what's coming' part, chapter changes, before/after examples: does it sound like one person following a thought, not 'Point one…' templates or a TOC read aloud? Do adjacent lines connect?
Ear only: one new idea per line; clear reference ('this' points to something); terms explained before used; numbers and words not misheard
No filler, repetition, or empty truisms; point out lines that could go without losing anything
One warm, clear, unpretentious narrator throughout; varied sentence length; each line sayable in one breath
For every 'a bit off' / 'clearly off' line, a drop-in rewrite no longer than the original; rank the 5 most awkward lines
examples: 'In this episode: What the problem is. Why memorizing answers fails.' — a table of contents read aloud (caught by the user)

The Chinese line 「再聊聊它在现实里闯过的祸，和怎么防」 passed three review rounds although no one talks like that; the English equivalent of this pattern is a noun phrase glued to 'and how to…' (e.g. 'real-world failures, and how to avoid them')

items.name: 中文屏幕文字（PPT 式画面）
items.who: 你是做过多年发布会和科普视频的中文版式编辑（参考：苹果发布会、得到、回形针 PaperClip 的屏幕文字），也是中文母语观众。
items.what: 逐屏看画面上的中文字：是不是只列纲要、够不够简练、和口播有没有分工、看不看得完。
items.why: 上一版屏幕文字很多是整句（如「另训一个模型，在两家医院的片子上认医院的准确率——胸片里藏着医院的“指纹”」），等于把口播又印了一遍；用户要求画面只列纲要、相对简练（2026-11-08）。
items.limits: 硬上限（超了必须报）：标题 ≤12 字；其余每块 ≤16 字；同屏文字块 ≤4 块（不含页眉小标签、出处与图表刻度）；一屏总字数 ≤36 字。屏幕下方还有口播字幕，观众要同时看。计数口径（第 2 轮裁决定，2026-11-09）：页眉小标签、案例页签、出处、片尾署名不计；同构的列表 / 表格 / 卡片行（每项 ≤8 字、最多 6 项、样子一样）合算 1 块，编号不计字；图里的文字（区域名、曲线名、轴标题、柱条标签、图上注释）要计字数，整张图合算 1 块，只有坐标刻度数字豁免；表格的列头算在表里。
dims: 每屏只放关键词、短语、关键数字、标签；不是口播整句的复述。按硬上限逐屏数字数，超了就报
屏幕给结构、数字、对比，口播负责解释；不和口播逐字重复，也不出现口播没说过的新说法；术语、叫法与口播一致
一眼先看到什么、第二眼看什么；标题—要点—注释不超过三级；编号、标签、章节名、目录项前后一致（例：目录写的和章节卡写的是不是同一个说法）
短语化、不带句末句号；标点、引号、空格规范；不半中半英；**标题、章名读出来要顺**：名词堆砌、生造的名词短语（如「现实里的祸」）算必改
按截图和停留时间：文字量在停留时间内读得完（约 6 字/秒，还要分神看字幕和图）
每处超限或不顺的屏幕文字，都给出更短、可直接替换的写法
examples: 本期内容卡把口播的四句整句印在屏上，不是纲要（用户抓到）
x2 一块 40 多字的整句说明，与口播重复
章节标题「现实里的祸」「怎么发现，怎么防」读着就不是人话（用户 2026-11-09）

items.name: English on-screen text (slides)
items.who: You are an English-native presentation editor (think Apple keynotes, Kurzgesagt, Vox explainers) and a native viewer.
items.what: Screen by screen: is the on-screen English an outline (not prose), tight, divided from the narration, and readable in time?
items.why: The previous version put full sentences on screen (e.g. 'A separate model identified the hospital for scans from two hospitals — a hospital fingerprint'), repeating the narration. The user wants outline-only, concise slides (2026-11-08).
items.limits: Hard limits (report every breach): title ≤6 words; any other block ≤9 words; ≤4 text blocks per screen (not counting the small eyebrow label, source line or chart ticks); ≤22 words per screen. Narration subtitles also sit at the bottom of the frame. Counting rules (round-2 ruling, 2026-11-09): eyebrow labels, case tabs, source lines and end-card credits are exempt; a list, table or card row of look-alike items (each ≤6 words, at most 6 items) counts as one block, and numbering doesn't count as words; in-chart text (zone names, curve names, axis titles, bar labels, callouts) counts toward words and the whole chart counts as one block — only axis tick numbers are exempt; a table's column headers count with the table.
dims: Only keywords, short phrases, key numbers, labels; no full narration sentences. Count words per screen against the hard limits
Screen carries structure, numbers, contrasts; narration explains. No verbatim repetition, no new claims the narration doesn't make; terms match the narration
What reads first, second; ≤3 levels (title, point, note); numbering, labels, chapter names and agenda items consistent with each other

Sentence case headline style; no Chinglish; consistent punctuation (no trailing periods on fragments), en dashes, quotes; parallel grammar in lists; **chapter titles and headings must read naturally aloud** — awkward noun stacks are must-fix
From the screenshot and how long it stays: readable in time (~3 words/s while also reading subtitles and the chart)
For every breach or awkward phrase, a shorter drop-in rewrite
examples: The agenda card printed four narration sentences — not an outline (caught by the user)

output.zh:
报告格式：
1. `## 评分表`：每个维度一行 `- <编号> <0–3> 证据：…`（0 分写 `原因：…`）；第 2、3 轮另写 `- R <0–3> 证据：…` 逐条复核上一轮。
2. `## 问题表`，每个问题一行，按严重度排序：

| 位置 | 维度 | 级别 | 原文 | 问题 | 改写 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

位置写句号 lNN 或屏号（屏号就是该屏对应的句号，包装卡写卡名，如 agenda、c_problem）；级别只用：必改（不自然到观众会出戏、看不懂、超硬上限、与口播矛盾）/ 建议 / 记录 / 存疑。改写给可直接替换的本语言文字。全部没问题写一行「结论：无问题」。
3. `## 整体观察`（≤8 行），含「做得好、别改掉的」三条以内。
output.en:
Report format (write in English):
1. `## 评分表` (score table): one line per dimension `- <ID> <0–3> 证据：…` (score 0 → `原因：…`); rounds 2–3 add `- R <0–3> 证据：…` re-checking each previous issue.
2. `## 问题表` (issues), one row per issue, most severe first:

| 位置 | 维度 | 级别 | 原文 | 问题 | 改写 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

位置 = line id lNN or screen id (the line it plays with; package cards by name, e.g. agenda, c_problem). 级别 (level) must be one of: 必改 (must fix: a native viewer would wince / not follow / hard limit broken / contradicts narration), 建议 (suggest), 记录 (note), 存疑 (unsure). 改写 = drop-in English rewrite. If nothing is wrong, write one line 「结论：无问题」.
3. `## 整体观察` (≤8 lines), including up to three things that work and must be kept.

strict.zh: 从严条目（每一轮都一样，不因为是最后一轮放宽）：开场、串场（本期要讲什么、章节过渡）、片尾这几类句子，以及屏幕上的章节标题，只要判「有点怪」就算必改。
strict.en: Strict items (same in every round, never relaxed in the last round): the cold open, linking lines (what's coming, chapter transitions), the outro, and on-screen chapter titles — anything 'a bit off' there is 必改 (must fix).

retell.zh: 逐句复述（必做，缺了报告不合格）：在「## 逐句复述」表里，每一句都先写出「如果我跟朋友聊天说这个意思，会怎么说」，再和原句比：句式、用词明显不同（名词化、名词短语加「和」再接问句、书面词、报菜名）就判「有点怪」或「很怪」。表头：| 句号 | 原句 | 跟朋友会怎么说 | 判 |
retell.en: Line-by-line retell (required; a report without it is rejected): in a `## 逐句复述` table, for every line first write how you would say the same thing to a friend in conversation, then compare: if the structure or wording clearly differs (nominalized phrases, noun phrase + 'and how to…', written-style words, list-reading), mark it 'a bit off' or 'clearly off'. Header: | 句号 | 原句 | 跟朋友会怎么说 | 判 |
